clean_apply.method: the generated patch reverse-applies cleanly to the current overlay on the pinned base, proving the overlay bytes are exactly the patch result

corpus_audit.qualification: the retained corpus audit did not contain R_ARM_TARGET2; this milestone is driven by pinned LLD source, its existing EHABI test and an executed relocation-complete generated fixture, not a corpus-frequency claim

scope_limits: AAELF32 leaves R_ARM_TARGET2 platform-defined; FirmBOLT requires the exact bare-metal ABS32 or REL32 link policy and never infers it from the image
the Linux-default GOT-relative interpretation remains unsupported until a complete qualified GOT dependency graph is represented

an incorrectly declared ABS32-versus-REL32 policy is not always distinguishable from an arbitrary SHT_REL addend when the linked place and symbol remain fixed; the link policy is therefore part of the input identity
the accepted fixture keeps the extab and referenced type-info object fixed; moving language-specific data requires a separately complete reference and placement contract
the production matrix demonstrates no regression across the existing firmware corpus, not complete x86-backend parity
the milestone establishes relocation, EHABI publication and architectural execution correctness, not a performance result

source.aaelf32: R_ARM_TARGET2 is a platform relocation whose selected expression may be ABS32, REL32 or GOT-relative
source.pinned_lld: lld/ELF/Arch/ARM.cpp maps --target2=abs and --target2=rel to the bare-metal forms and lld/test/ELF/arm-target2.s identifies .ARM.extab as the intended use
source.policy_boundary: FirmBOLT implements explicit ABS32 and REL32 policies and rejects the default/unqualified and GOT-relative cases

target2_contract.default_policy: reject atomically with no candidate; the diagnostic names both supported bare-metal policies and states that GOT-relative is unsupported
target2_contract.formula: S+A-P for the qualified REL32 form; S+A for the qualified ABS32 form
target2_contract.handler: BOLT recognizes, sizes, extracts, range-checks and encodes R_ARM_TARGET2 according to the explicit link policy and records it as a code-section dependency
target2_contract.transformation: whole-image ordering moves the personality and worker functions while compact publication shrinks .text from 38 to 36 bytes; the fixed extab/type-info dependency and exact instruction origins survive
